title: Cohort bundler v2: deterministic compaction and lightweight onboarding probe
author: Maya Chen
ci_status: pass (two reruns for flaky timing check)
release_notes: Adds deterministic cohort compaction algorithm for bundle size control; introduces a lightweight onboarding probe that validates profile completeness and basic latency/throughput guards; auto-drafts a short release-note fragment when a cohort bundle is produced; feature flag gated.
description: This PR implements a second iteration of the cohort bundler with deterministic compaction rules and a separate lightweight onboarding probe. Motivation: we need compact, stable cohort bundles for routing heuristics and for producing concise changelog fragments tied to cohorts. The probe helps detect missing metadata and large deviations in median latency early in the onboarding flow. Changes include a new deterministic compaction step that merges small shard profiles into stable cohort groups based on workload fingerprinting and hardware affinity. The bundler emits a compact manifest with cohort_id, hardware_tier, representative_prompt_hashes, and a compact performance summary. The onboarding probe is a small runner that executes a sampled prompt set against a generated bundle, validates required metadata fields, checks median and p95 latency against configured thresholds, and emits a probe_report.json and a short human summary string for the console. Both components are opt-in behind a feature flag named enable_cohort_bundles. The PR adds unit tests covering compaction edge cases, an integration smoke test that runs the bundler and probe on a synthetic fixture, a docs page describing the bundle manifest and operational playbook, and a simple release-note hook that generates a skeleton changelog entry when new cohorts are published. CI initially failed due to a flaky sleep in the probe test; the test was adjusted to use a percentile-based assertion and the pipeline was retriggered. Reviewers asked for a max_bundle_size guard and a stable manifest version field; both were added. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 72 hours, inspect probe reports and routing deltas, then progressively enable for 1% of production routing decisions. Follow-ups: ENG-4120 to surface probe summaries in the onboarding UI, ENG-4211 to add bundle compaction telemetry, ENG-4289 to add a manual recompact CLI. Risk mitigations: raw profile shards are retained so teams can pin routes to raw profiles; probe runs asynchronously by default and blocks rollout only on critical failures. Merge: squash-merged to main on 2024-12-13 after approvals and green CI.
notes: If you need to reproduce the integration test locally run: tox -e registry-integration -- tests/fixtures/cohort_synthetic.json. The new manifest is versioned as v0.2 and includes sample_stats.summary_median and sample_stats.p95 fields.
